# My Halo Auto

> My Halo Auto is a mobile auto repair and maintenance service for personal and fleet vehicles in Washington DC, Maryland and Northern Virginia (the DMV). An ASE-certified technician with 5+ years of hands-on experience performs the work at the customer's location (home, office, lot, yard or job site) where there is adequate, safe workspace. My Halo Auto specializes in maintenance and repair, not performance enhancement.

Last updated: 2026-10-01

## Key facts

- Business: My Halo Auto
- Type: Mobile auto maintenance and repair (we come to you)
- Owner: Joseph, ASE-certified technician, 5+ years hands-on experience
- Certification: ASE certified
- Experience: 5+ years
- Vehicles: Personal and fleet/company vehicles, all makes and models (domestic, import, European)
- Fleet vehicles: company and fleet vehicles such as work vans, pickups, sedans and SUVs; service on-site at your lot, yard or job site where there is adequate, safe workspace; the same service catalog as personal vehicles; scheduling arranged with your fleet manager; a single ASE-certified point of contact; an itemized invoice for each vehicle
- No towing needed: the technician comes to the vehicle at your home, office, lot, yard or job site
- Emergency: emergency mobile service available; call (571) 969-4256
- Service area: Washington DC; Maryland (towns in Montgomery and Prince George's counties, plus Columbia, Glen Burnie, Frederick, Prince Frederick); Northern Virginia (plus Stafford and Fredericksburg). Full town list below
- Hours: Mon–Sat 7AM–7PM; Sunday by request
- Response: Typically within 12 hours during business hours
- Standards: every fastener torqued to manufacturer specification; OEM repair procedures
- Google rating: 5.0 (Google Business Profile, as of 2026-10-01)
- Phone: (571) 969-4256
- Email: myhaloauto@gmail.com

## How to book

- Call or text (571) 969-4256, email myhaloauto@gmail.com, or use the form at https://myhaloauto.com/#contact
- Include the vehicle's year, make and model and a description of the issue
- You get a transparent quote with no hidden fees; we explain every repair before we start, and you approve the work
- We typically respond within 12 hours during business hours

## Service area

Washington, DC
- Washington, DC, including Northwest DC, Northeast DC, Southeast DC, Southwest DC, Capitol Hill and Georgetown

Maryland
- Montgomery County: Bethesda, Germantown, Kensington, Potomac, Rockville, Silver Spring, Takoma Park
- Prince George's County: Bowie, Cheverly, College Park, Fort Washington, Greenbelt, Hyattsville, Landover, Largo, Laurel, Suitland, Upper Marlboro
- Elsewhere in Maryland: Columbia (Howard County), Glen Burnie (Anne Arundel County), Frederick (Frederick County), Prince Frederick (Calvert County)

Northern Virginia
- Arlington County: Arlington, Rosslyn
- City of Alexandria: Alexandria
- Fairfax County, Fairfax and Falls Church: Annandale, Burke, Centreville, Chantilly, Fairfax, Falls Church, Herndon, Lorton, McLean, Merrifield, Oakton, Reston, Springfield, Tysons, Vienna, Woodlawn
- Loudoun County: Ashburn, Leesburg, Sterling
- Prince William County and Manassas: Dale City, Dumfries, Gainesville, Haymarket, Lake Ridge, Manassas, Occoquan, Woodbridge
- Further south: Stafford, Fredericksburg

Not listed? Choose Other on the quote form or call or text (571) 969-4256.

## Not offered / by consultation

- Not offered: painting, bodywork, performance upgrades, coilover installation
- By consultation: engine swaps (not a mobile service; require adequate workspace, proper equipment and a suitable location), exhaust and custom fabrication
- Mobile service requires adequate workspace and a suitable area to work safely, such as a flat driveway, parking lot or garage.
